title: Congestion Avoidance and Control

date.notes: SIGCOMM 1988 paper; LBL-hosted copy is a slightly revised later rendering of the 1988 work.

publisher_or_issuer: ACM SIGCOMM / Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory author archive

claims_extracted.claim: The paper attributes much observed severe Internet congestion to transport-protocol implementation behavior and organizes solutions around a packet-conservation principle.
The paper describes algorithms including improved RTT/RTO estimation, exponential backoff, slow start and congestion-avoidance behavior implemented in 4BSD TCP work.
claims_extracted.notes: Separate exact algorithm/source-release dates in later records.

notes: Key contemporary source for the implementation lineage that later becomes central to modern TCP congestion control.
